'''Meghna Group''' is a [[Bangladesh]]i [[conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]]. It is present in automobile, light engineering, bicycle, tire, cement, packaging and textile industries. Meghna Group was established by Mizanur Rahman Bhuiyan.<ref name="thedailystar.net">{{cite news |last1=Chowdhury |first1=Sarwar A. |title=Bangladesh Business Awards 2008 |url=https://archive.thedailystar.net/suppliments/2009/bus_award/enterprise.htm|work=The Daily Star |date=April 2009}}</ref> It is Bangladesh's largest bicycle manufacturer and exporter. Meghna Group is also into the manufacture and export of garments. 
Meghna Group is also a car distributor for BMW, KIA, and Ford in Bangladesh. Recently, the company has started car manufacturing under the name of  Meghna Car Manufacturing Ltd.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.meghnagroup.com.bd|title=Meghna Group|publisher=|access-date=11 January 2017}}</ref>

Meghna Group has also invested in Prime Bank, a commercial bank in Bangladesh.<ref>{{cite web |title=Finance |url=https://meghna.com.bd/industries/finance/ |website=Meghna Corporation}}</ref>

==History==
In January 2023, M&U Motors has launched Ford in Bangladesh as exclusive distributor of different models of Ford passenger and commercial vehicles.
In June 2023, Executive Motors launches BMW 735i in Bangladesh.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.tbsnews.net/economy/corporates/bmw-735i-launched-bangladesh-652542 | title=BMW 735i launched in Bangladesh | date=19 June 2023 }}</ref>
In 2024, Meghna Car Manufacturing started its operation by assembling KIA passenger cars in Bangladesh.
